quote: Recent work in the field of explainable QA includes... generating freeform explanations and reasoning chains.

We present RLET, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) based Entailment Tree generation framework ... We evaluate our approach on EntailmentBank, a benchmark that provides expert-annotated explanations of QA pairs in the form of entailment trees.
Our goal is to provide a step-by-step reasoning process for commonsense science questions, with prior knowledge of the question, the correct answer and a set of fact sentences.

quote: Dalvi et al. introduces four standard metrics to automatically evaluate the entailment tree.

Intermediates (BLEURT, AllCorrect) evaluate the generation quality of the intermediate conclusions. Steps (F1, AllCorrect) mainly evaluate the structure correctness of the trees. Leaves (F1, AllCorrect) evaluate how well the model performs in identifying facts.
